### What does this skill do?
Subjects every non-trivial decision to a fresh-context adversarial review before it stands. Use when correctness matters more than speed, when working in unfamiliar code, when stakes are high (production, security-sensitive logic, irreversible operations), or any time a confident output would be cheaper to verify now than to debug later.

### Why is it worth installing?

One question at a time until ~95% confidence — extracting what you actually want, not what you think you should want.

### What does this skill do?
Extracts what the user actually wants instead of what they think they should want. Achieves this through one-question-at-a-time interview until ~95% confidence about the underlying intent. Use when an ask is underspecified ("build me X" without "for whom" or "why now"), when the user explicitly invokes ("interview me", "grill me", "are we sure?", "stress-test my thinking"), or when you catch yours

### Why is it worth installing?
Wrong requirements waste everything downstream; interrogation-first saves the whole project's rework.

### What does this skill do?
从小说或短故事里拆出角色表、人物画像、形象提示词、音色提示词， 并给每个角色出角色设定图（左半身像 + 右全身三视图 + 细节条），产出 JSON + Markdown + 可交互的 report.html。 报告语言可指定（--lang），默认中文，任意语言都支持； 出图风格可指定（--style），默认半写实，也可以出吉卜力动画风。 零依赖、零 API key，用当前会话额度；出图走 codex 内置 $imagegen（可选）。 Use when asked to 拆小说角色、分析人物、生成角色卡、character sheets from a novel。

### How do you install it?

### Where does it come from?
Repository: eternityspring/shuohao-skills The repository ships 1 skills in total.

--- 中文 ---
开拍前先把人设、关系和能演的动作拆开

### Q：这个 skill 做什么？
从小说或短故事里拆出角色表、人物画像、形象提示词、音色提示词， 并给每个角色出角色设定图（左半身像 + 右全身三视图 + 细节条），产出 JSON + Markdown + 可交互的 report.html。 报告语言可指定（--lang），默认中文，任意语言都支持； 出图风格可指定（--style），默认半写实，也可以出吉卜力动画风。 零依赖、零 API key，用当前会话额度；出图走 codex 内置 $imagegen（可选）。 Use when asked to 拆小说角色、分析人物、生成角色卡、character sheets from a novel。

### Q：为什么值得装？
说浩这套里真正能上手的是拆角色：人设、关系、能演的动作，不是「一键写全集」。

### Q：怎么装？
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/eternityspring/shuohao-skills.git 然后把智能体指向这个 skill 目录即可。

### Q：它从哪来？
Repository: eternityspring/shuohao-skills The repository ships 1 skills in total.

Updated: 2026-08-14
Tags: everyday, skill, fxw-labs

What is diggable in the two hours around a spring low tide, and when to turn back before the water closes in. Safe-exit time comes first, harvest second, across 51 sites in 11 coastal provinces.

### What does this skill do?
What is diggable in the two hours around a spring low tide, and when to turn back before the water closes in. Safe-exit time comes first, harvest second, across 51 sites in 11 coastal provinces.

### Why is it worth installing?
The rare part is the ceiling it puts on itself: when it falls back to an astronomical skeleton estimate, the suitability rating is capped at the second of five levels rather than faked.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/fxw-labs/beachcombing.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

## human-writing
## 按活人那套改中文长文
URL: https://ourword.ai/skill/i/kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing/
URL (中文): https://ourword.ai/skill/zh/i/kkkkhazix-human-writing-human-writing/
Source: https://github.com/KKKKhazix/human-writing/tree/HEAD/human-writing
Updated: 2026-08-11
Tags: writing, skill, KKKKhazix

Makes Chinese read like a person who has seen things, checked sources and wants to explain properly — long answers, articles, scripts and dialogue alike.

### What does this skill do?
通用中文创作与改稿 Skill。用于知乎回答、论坛长帖、公众号文章、博客、评论、人物故事、历史叙事、新闻与行业解读、科普、教程、评测、个人叙事、小说、故事、对白、口播和演讲稿。默认写成一个见过事、查过材料、愿意把来龙去脉讲清楚的人在说话，重点保留中文互联网长回答与长帖的活人感和自然中文韵律，避免空泛的机构腔、喊口号式演说腔、营销腔和模型腔。非虚构长文先检查材料够不够，材料不足时研究、追问或缩短，绝不用重复解释灌字数。现实内容额外核验事实、引语、数据与用户亲历，虚构内容可以创造人物、场景、对白、心理与情节。成稿正文严禁冒号、破折号、“不是……而是……”及同类翻案句，并清除商业黑话和模型惯用黑话。不创建作者画像、个人规则库或个人写作 Skill。

### Why is it worth installing?
Installing a specific human voice beats blacklisting AI words — the first governs syntax and point of view, the second only swaps vocabulary. Chinese original, not a translation.

### How do you install it?
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/KKKKhazix/human-writing.git Then point your agent at the skill directory.

### Where does it come from?
Repository: KKKKhazix/human-writing Prep work visible in the skill's own text: reference files, runnable scripts, stated boundaries. The repository ships 1 skills in total.

### What does this skill do?

### Q：这个 skill 做什么？
真随机起卦的周易/易经占卜。用密码学级随机数模拟三枚铜钱起卦,绝不编造卦象;一事一占;按传统规范解读本卦、动爻、之卦,先引原文再讲白话;凶卦如实直断;支持事后对账验证。只要用户提到占卜、算卦、起卦、问卦、解卦、摇卦、占一卦、六十四卦、易经、周易、卦象,或想用易经视角推演某个决定(跳槽、感情、合作、出行、时机),就使用本 skill,即使他没有明说"占卜"二字。Authentic I Ching (Yijing/Zhouyi) divination - cryptographically random coin casting, classical hexagram interpretation

### Q：为什么值得装？
「绝不编造卦象」「凶卦如实直断」——它把占卜里最容易滑坡的那两处堵死了。认真对待玩的东西，本身就是一种品味。

### Q：怎么装？
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/neallydare-svg/iching-divination.git 然后把智能体指向这个 skill 目录即可。
